components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared action treatment; theme variables inherit from the application.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; padding:10px 14px; font:500 12px/18px Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--hover); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button:active { transform:translateY(1px); }.ds-button { background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); color:#141515; font-weight:650; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--accent-hover); }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Shared action treatment; theme variables inherit from the application.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; padding:10px 14px; font:500 12px/18px Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--hover); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Destructive button
components.description: Shared action treatment; theme variables inherit from the application.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; padding:10px 14px; font:500 12px/18px Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--hover); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button:active { transform:translateY(1px); }.ds-button { background:var(--danger); border-color:var(--danger); color:var(--on-danger); } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--danger); filter:brightness(.95); }

components.name: Text field
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; font:13px Inter,sans-serif; color:var(--text); } .ds-input { padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font:14px Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--faint); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Workout card
components.description: Sport, title and prescription remain grouped.
components.css: .ds-workout { display:grid; gap:4px; width:100%; padding:10px 8px; text-align:left; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:5px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font:12px Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-sport { color:var(--accent-ink); } .ds-workout > span:last-child { color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; } .ds-workout:hover { border-color:var(--accent-line); background:var(--surface-raised); } .ds-workout:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Active navigation
components.description: Text identifies the destination; orange marks the current page.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:block; padding:11px 12px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent-ink); font:13px Inter,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav:hover { background:var(--hover); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
The owner confirmed this direction on 2026-10-25: compact, restrained, orange accents and flat graphite/light surfaces. The interface serves repeated planning and review. Dates, session titles, measured values and actions establish hierarchy; decorative treatments should not compete with them.

This record captures the existing visual system and is maintained with refinements. [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) owns audience and product principles; [feature specifications](README.md#documentation) own behavior. The [original mockups](docs/design/mockups/) remain preserved references. The [execution record](docs/plans/mvp-execution.md) owns individual results and verification.
keyCharacteristics: Compact weekly structure with a clear date rhythm.
Orange reserved for primary actions, current selection and the current day.
Flat surfaces distinguished by restrained borders and tonal changes.
Equivalent light and dark themes with consistent semantic meaning.
Familiar controls, explicit labels, and factual measurements.
dos: Do preserve the paired themes and semantic color roles.
Do prioritize legible dates, session names, recorded values and actions.
Do verify desktop planning and phone review/logging with realistic synthetic data.
Do use shared primitives for shared interaction patterns and plugin-local styles for feature-specific composition.
Do distinguish missing measurements from zero and planned training from recorded facts.
donts: Don't replace the compact calendar with decorative dashboard tiles.
Don't use color alone to communicate completion, injury or missing data.
Don't hide essential phone actions behind hover.
Don't add arbitrary scores, unsupported capabilities or factual claims as decoration.
Don't let a CSS override make a destructive action or focus indicator unreadable.
